about: FireTake 3.0 module registry: what exists, which stage it belongs to, and the acceptance metric that closes it. npm run status reads this with the latest test results.

modules.name: PDF objects (line / polyline / polygon / rect / circle / arc, colour, weight, dash)
Sheet classification (cover / legend / notes / plan / schematic / detail / site)
PDF markups kept out of geometry, read for verification
Legend analysis — text-layer legends (sections, symbols, line types, abbreviations)
Legend analysis — CAD-lettered legends (no text layer)
modules.note: exists in the app UI flow (lgRows), not yet inside FVE

modules.name: Rule engine (tag + shape + context rules, evidence, confidence)
Verification (level outliers, unused legend rows, unknown tags, markups)
Pipe / cable lengths from legend line types
Room detection (walls + room names → closed spaces)
Loop detection and loop cable length
FVE results into the app (marks, runs, BOQ, quote)
modules.note: BOQ / quote already exist in the app; FVE output is not wired into them yet
